chunks: Those of the right hand -- how (happy) will be those of the right hand!

key_terms.أَصْحَابُ: Companions or people associated with a specific group
key_terms.الْمَيْمَنَةِ: The Right Hand, symbolizing honor, success, and receiving the book of deeds on the right side

ai.seo_question: Who are the Companions of the Right Hand in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted through the lens of the Ahl al-Bayt, who are considered the ultimate 'Companions of the Right Hand' due to their unwavering fidelity and spiritual purity. The exclamatory nature of the phrase underscores the profound joy and divine proximity granted to those whose deeds are recorded with honor, distinguishing them from the 'Companions of the Left.' This concept reinforces the Shia emphasis on the intercession of the Imams and the merit of following the Prophet's household as the path to ultimate success.
